Move to a larger machine, giving the size by name and a reason naming the command, its exit or error, and the workers or threads it used. You run on Small (2 CPUs · 4 GiB · 20 GiB). Larger sizes you may move to: Large (4 · 16). A successful request ends your turn: you are resumed on the new size. A move keeps your conversation and checkout; running processes and /tmp are not kept.
